llm.summary: This skill is a narrow code-review style prompt that only asks the agent to identify unnecessary complexity in diffs and does not request tools, persistence, credentials, or code execution.

dimensions.detail: The skill does not ask for filesystem mutation, shell commands, network access, credentials, local indexing, or external services.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact is a single Markdown skill file with frontmatter metadata and no executable installer, dependencies, scripts, or bundled code.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The natural-language deactivation phrase could be triggered accidentally, but it only changes review verbosity/style and does not create high-impact authority or hidden behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background execution, memory writes, or tool hijacking instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose and artifact content are coherent: it reviews diffs for over-engineering and emits concise findings without applying fixes.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this skill intentionally narrows reviews to over-engineering and tells the agent to route correctness, security, and performance issues to a normal review pass; use it when you want a terse complexity-focused review, not a comprehensive code review.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The stop/normal-mode phrase is a purpose-aligned user control for leaving the terse review style. It is somewhat ambiguous but the impact is limited to style behavior, so it does not justify Review by itself.
